Welcome to the **Plot2Publish** workshop! Here you will find the reference material covered during the theoretical sessions. Use these pages alongside the practical exercise notebooks provided during the workshop.

---

### DAY 1

**Session 1: Code context**

- Versioning
- Dependencies
- Environment management (Conda / renv)

**Session 2: Version Control**

- Repositories & commits
- Local vs remote (Git & GitHub)
- README, `.gitignore`, and your GitHub homepage

---

### DAY 2

**Session 3: Collaboration**

- Code smells & code review
- Issues, branches & pull requests

**Session 4: Prepare to Publish!**

- Licensing
- Releases & DOIs (Zenodo)
- Data repositories & final checklist
